Logical responsibility architecture - not a physical deployment topology or mandatory execution pipeline

HDIP - Enterprise Logical Platform Composition & Realization

Foundation enables realization; it does not establish semantics, Product qualification, policy authority or enterprise accountability.
• HDIP is one integrated logical architecture
• Data, Information and Intelligence responsibilities remain distinct
• Architecture is graph-shaped, not a universal linear pipeline
• Shared realization does not transfer authority
• Visual omission does not waive obligations
• PDEP = Product Development & Evolution; not a Plane
• CEP = Consumer Experience Projection; not a Plane
• Historical COVP responsibilities mainly decompose across X4, X9 and P5
• Historical Governance Plane and Utility Plane do not replace the canonical Overlay and Foundation models

HDIP composes and realizes governed Data, Information and Intelligence responsibilities as one enterprise logical platform while preserving independent semantic, Product, policy, source and Decision authorities.
